TRAMPOLI / compact

A compact box. A complete visual navigation system.

VISUAL IDEA

Design,
assembled in volume.

A line drawing communicates the chandelier construction without competing with the copy. Black information panels establish a clear hierarchy on warm kraft.

The pattern extends across the side panels to unify the package. Product illustration, features, a technical table and required markings share one system.
